node.title: PMA arbitrary-petal maximal-source realizability
node.statement: For every partition of an evaluation domain into a (k-1)-point core, arbitrary disjoint ell-point petals, and background b<ell, distinct nonzero labels define an explicit received word U whose codewords c_i L_C have exact agreement sets C union T_i. At M=floor((n-k+1)/ell) this is a maximal sunflower source. A smooth F_17^* instance has four quadratic petal locators with different linear coefficients, so maximal-source structure alone cannot force a common constant-shift pencil. This does not construct an unpaid residual contributor; any surviving bridge must be contributor-specific or the arbitrary-locator branch must be counted directly.
